userStories.title: Wire FilterChain.apply() as extensible pre-execution gate
userStories.description: FilterChain is initialized in ExecutionManager.__init__ but apply() is never called. Register a spread_filter wrapper at init time. In execute_trade() after _phase49_size_multiplier is finalized (~line 2176), call _filter_chain.apply(context_dict). BLOCK returns ExecutionResult(success=False). REDUCE_SIZE compounds on _phase49_size_mult. Fail-open (exceptions pass through).
acceptanceCriteria: FilterChain.apply(context) called in execute_trade() after _phase49_size_multiplier block
context dict includes pair, direction, confidence, atr, spread_pips, atr_pips, volatility_regime, phase49_size_multiplier
BLOCK result returns ExecutionResult(success=False, error='BLOCKED by filter chain: ...')
REDUCE_SIZE result multiplies _phase49_size_mult and updates ctx['_phase49_size_multiplier']
Entire block wrapped in try/except (fail-open)
Early skip if _filter_chain is None or has no registered filters
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: FilterResult has: passed, action (PASS/BLOCK/REDUCE_SIZE), reason, size_multiplier, filter_name. get_filter_names() checks if chain has filters.

userStories.title: Wire PositionTimeoutManager — tick/register/evaluate/close
userStories.description: PositionTimeoutManager is initialized in Scanner.__init__ gated by enable_position_timeout (default True). Wire 4 call sites: (A) tick() once per scan() cycle before trailing stop eval; (B) evaluate_all() in scan() to detect timed-out trades and force-close; (C) register_trade() in _init_executor() injection so executor can register after trade fill; (D) close_trade() in sync_closed_trades_rl() when trade is confirmed closed. Pass scanner._position_timeout reference to executor via new _position_timeout_mgr attr.
acceptanceCriteria: _position_timeout_mgr: Optional[Any] = None added to ExecutionManager.__init__
After executor creation in _init_executor(), set self._executor._position_timeout_mgr = self._position_timeout
tick() called once per scan() cycle (after _scan_cycle_count increment)
evaluate_all() called in scan() — forced exits logged at WARNING, close_trade() deregisters
register_trade(trade_id, regime, confidence, pair, direction) called post-execute in execution.py (via _position_timeout_mgr)
close_trade(tid) called in sync_closed_trades_rl() when trade confirmed closed
All 4 sites wrapped in try/except (non-blocking)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: evaluate_all() returns List[TimeoutResult]. TimeoutResult has: should_exit, trade_id, exit_reason. register_trade() signature: trade_id, regime, confidence, pair, direction.

userStories.title: Wire RegimeConfidenceScorer risk_pct scaling in _scan_pair()
userStories.description: RegimeConfidenceScorer exists in ExecutionManager but is never called. Add a second instance in Scanner.__init__ so _scan_pair() can use it. After the entropy sizer block (~line 3756) and after regime_name is finalized, call score(adx, atr_percentile, trend_strength, regime) → sizing_factor. Multiply risk_pct by sizing_factor when < 1.0 (transition/uncertain regimes reduce position size).
acceptanceCriteria: self._regime_confidence_scorer added to Scanner.__init__ lazy init block
score() called in _scan_pair() after entropy_sizer block AND after regime_name is finalized
adx read from df_feat['adx'] or df_feat['adx_14'] (fallback 25.0)
atr_percentile from metrics.get('volatility_percentile', 0.5)
trend_strength from metrics.get('trend_strength', 0.5)
risk_pct *= sizing_factor when sizing_factor < 1.0
INFO log when sizing_factor < 1.0 with tier, factor, old→new risk_pct
DEBUG log when full size (sizing_factor == 1.0)
Wrapped in try/except (non-blocking)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: score() signature: score(adx, atr_percentile, trend_strength, current_regime). Returns RegimeScoreResult with sizing_factor, tier, is_transition.

userStories.title: Wire CausalCounterfactual post-loss analysis in sync_closed_trades_rl()
userStories.description: CounterfactualEngine is initialized in Scanner.__init__ (line 1054) but analyze_trade() / batch_analyze() are never called. In sync_closed_trades_rl(), after the PairAffinityTracker block, iterate losing trades and run batch_analyze(). Log the most impactful reversal scenario at INFO. save_analysis() persists to counterfactual_log.jsonl for future ML feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: CausalCounterfactual block runs after PairAffinityTracker block in sync_closed_trades_rl()
Only loss trades analyzed (realized_pl < 0)
Capped at 5 losses per sync call (prevent latency spike on batch close)
generate_standard_scenarios(trade_context) called to get scenario list
batch_analyze(trade_context, scenarios) called for each losing trade
save_analysis(tid, results) persists results to disk
Most impactful reversal scenario (max |probability_delta|) logged at INFO
Total losses analyzed logged at INFO when > 0
No exception propagation — errors caught at DEBUG
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: analyze_trade(trade_context, scenario) takes ONE scenario. batch_analyze(trade_context, scenarios) takes list. trade_context needs: pair, features dict, regime str, outcome float (0.0=loss). CounterfactualResult has: outcome_reversal bool, probability_delta float, explanation str, scenario.
